decision.summary: A high-amplitude multi-axis transient occurs at indices 525–530 (N drop, E dip, U spike), with incomplete recovery by 534. A secondary correlated N/U step-down appears ~545–555, possibly part of the same event’s return or a distinct offset; neither interval shows a confirmed opposing return within allowed context [450,699]. Numerical jump candidates at 466, 539, 553 do not align cleanly with observed multi-sample morphology and are not used to define intervals.

intervals.observation: N drops sharply over ~525–530 (multi-sample), E dips then rebounds, U spikes ~18 MAD then collapses; all three axes show coherent transient with clear onset and sustained interior before return begins. Return is incomplete by index 534 (U still elevated, N/E not fully recovered).

N and U show correlated step-down starting ~545, while E remains flat; this resembles a secondary offset or partial return of the earlier transient. No clear opposing return observed by 555; U does not recover to pre-525 level, and N shows only partial rebound. Coherence across N/U but not E weakens confidence.
